read: Legibility is the entire job: every record must be recognised in four bars by someone who does not like dance music.

tracks.title: One More Time
tracks.why: Fifteen thousand people know bar one; nobody is excluded
tracks.transition: Ride the horns, slam the next kick on the drop

tracks.title: Levels
tracks.why: Phones go up on the Etta sample, exactly as intended
tracks.transition: Cut to the next intro on the last bar of the build

tracks.title: Don't You Worry Child
tracks.why: Buys a singalong, which is the only rest a peak set gets
tracks.transition: Hold the vocal a cappella over the next four bars

tracks.title: Kernkraft 400
tracks.why: Wordless, tempo jumps twelve BPM and nobody objects
tracks.transition: Straight cut, no blend, let the gap land

tracks.title: Sandstorm
tracks.why: The most legible record ever made from 200 metres back
tracks.transition: Loop the riser, hold it four bars too long

tracks.title: Firestarter
tracks.why: Ends hardest, on a guitar, so even the sceptics get it
tracks.transition: Kill it dead on the last stab. CO2. Done.
